reports.title: Leonardo DRS Announces Financial Results for

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Leonardo DRS is increasing 2026 guidance for Revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Diluted EPS based on strong year-to-date performance, as specified in the table below:

Measure | Current 2026 Guidance | Prior 2026 Guidance
Revenue | $3,950 million - $3,985 million | $3,900 million - $3,975 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $545 million - $555 million | $525 million - $540 million
Tax Rate | 13.0% | 16.5%
Diluted WASO | 269.0 million | 269.0 million
Adjusted Diluted EPS | $1.50 - $1.53 | $1.34 - $1.39
The guidance excludes the pending acquisition of Raft LLC (“Raft”).
